g.text: Symbolic: a history of narrowing what to write down
Maybe we can just write it in logic
write facts about the world as logical statements and the machine infers
"to open a door you must be at it; opening it makes it open"
the wall: you must also write what does not change (the frame problem)
Give up the world, take one narrow field
medical diagnosis, system configuration: expert systems sold commercially
the wall: past a few thousand rules nobody could touch it
Make a standard and share it
RDF · OWL: the Semantic Web, making the whole web machine-readable
drop perfect inference, aim at usefulness. This one survived
Where the field is narrow and failure is expensive, it is still quietly running
